runbooks.title: Cannot reach an upstream service
runbooks.content: Possible causes: the upstream is down, DNS problems, certificate errors, routing or firewall changes, security group rules. Check whether the upstream is healthy and whether anything about connectivity changed recently.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: A default-deny egress NetworkPolicy was applied to namespace payments, blocking payments-api from reaching bank-partner-gateway
culprit_references: NetworkPolicy deny-egress-default applied to namespace payments
